name: pagination
description: The way through a long list a page at a time: Previous, the pages by number with gaps, and Next, each a plain link.

use.when: a list or a set of results is longer than reads well on one page.
use.not: steps in a task, which are a heading each; or tabs between views.
use.with: how many there are in all, said above the list.

href.description: The list's address, with its own query if it has one; the page is added as ?page=N.

label.description: Names the navigation, such as Pages of notes.

a11y.role: navigation holding a list of links, the page shown marked aria-current=page

keyboard.does: reaches Previous, each page and Next in turn

wcag.notes: A named navigation landmark (1.3.1). Each number is read as Page 3, and Previous and Next as Previous page and Next page (2.4.9). The page shown is marked with aria-current and filled, not only coloured (1.4.1). The gap is hidden from readers. Each link reaches 44px (2.5.5).

machine.identify: [aria-current=page] is the page shown; rel=prev and rel=next are the steps either side.
machine.operate: Follow a link to go to that page. An agent reading the list's JSON gets it whole instead.
